TaskDescription: Auditory perceptual threshold task: a 75 ms target sound (waterdrop, whistle or 'laser') embedded in continuous white noise at the participant's calibrated 50 % detection threshold (14 % blank trials), followed by two questions (heard? which sound?). Article section 2.2.
Instructions: Report whether a target sound was heard (yes/no buttons, counterbalanced), then identify it (guess if not heard).

Bandpass.Description: 0.4-1500.0 Hz corner frequencies stated in the article for Northwell Health

AuthorsProcessing.Description: Authors' epoching and artifact screening as released (sorted_trials file 'sorted_trials_all_gray_matter.mat'); see README. No filtering stated for the released epochs.

iEEGReference: Referential montage of the original acquisition: a single reference electrode selected by the clinical team (article section 2.4)
iEEGPlacementScheme: Clinically determined subdural grids, strips and depth electrodes; only grey-matter contacts released
